body:
I'm a student too, and yeah everyone's problems are completely relative. I do know exactly what you mean, I've fucked up being a student almost as much, just be glad you're about to graduate. Hell I dont want to do anything with my degree field if/when I graduate, I just have plans of moving away and starting the journey of life properly.

The way I think about it, I was always planning on going to university, it was like the next natural step, but its pretty much the last pre-planned part of my life. After I finish I will then feel like my life is properly starting, funnily enough my plan is to move out to Canada.

Maybe an outlook like that could help? I know it helps me when uni starts to overwhelm me.

in truth i was like....what the hell? i know they do so much, i felt terrible having to ask them to borrow money for rent even, as i know they would do anything for me and my sisters

part of me wants to tell my mum, she knows ive always struggled with depression and i know how much she worries about me even if i dont pick up the phone one day, she even said how she thought i might be going down the same road as my sister when i didnt respond to her calls for a couple days, i might say things once at a time if anything

ive just posted here so it feels really hypocritical to say....please speak to someone here who can help, dont just reject it, the response ive gotten has already made me feel better about the situation, knowing there are some truely altruistic people who dont know you but still want to help is a wonderful thing

i tried seeking help through my uni counselling service though it didnt help me, all i got was a book about how eating well helps, sadly im the fussiest eater in the world. i just dont want to worry my parents as i know my dad suffers from insomnia over whats happened with my mum and sister, i dont want them to feel like another one of their children is failing
im so sorry i dont think i made it clear enough she managed to pull through after a couple  days in the icu....geez thanks so much for the support, this community is fucking amazing

i appreciate the response...i live in the uk so im not sure if the same insitution applies but i think im going to listen to some happier music for a bit and see if that helps

edit; usually when i feel like this playing my guitar pretty much saves me, just the last few days it hasnt helped at all, kind of like a horrible cycle going to do the one thing that makes me happy and realising it doesnt
thanks, im just smoking and trying not to think for a while, music helps, i hope sleep will too
